label: Every NECESSARY_1 being either has the cause of its necessity from another…, from excluded middle
meaning: Bridge (#401), an instance of excluded middle: the tertia via's case split (STMT-NECESSARY-HAS-CAUSE-OF-NECESSITY-OR-NOT: every necessary being either has a cause of its necessity from another or does not) is one instance of excluded middle (STMT-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE) per necessary being. The proof only instantiates the premise; it connects the case split to the self-evident principle and closes nothing by its own content.
